title: A quenched SLE limit for weakly disordered FK–Ising interfaces
exact_target: For the specified weak two-valued random-bond FK model at $q=2$ and its physical critical coupling, does the conditional interface law converge in bounded-Lipschitz distance, in probability over disorder, to $SLE_{16/3}$ for every sufficiently small fixed disorder and every admissible marked planar domain?
